subject: English Home Language

show.line: Every sentence ends with a mark. A full stop, a question mark or an exclamation mark!

rounds.prompt: Where is my hat. Which mark should end this question?
rounds.praise: Yes! A question ends with a question mark.

rounds.prompt: The dog is brown. Which mark ends this telling sentence?
Watch out! Which mark shows a loud, excited shout?
Read this sentence out loud. Make your voice go up at the end.
Which sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop?
rounds.praise: Yes! Capital letter at the start, full stop at the end.

rounds.prompt: Question or telling sentence? Put each card in its group.
My name is Zola. What mark goes at the end? Say it.

hints: Asking something? Use a question mark.
Telling something? Use a full stop. Shouting? Exclamation mark.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will finish this sentence. What is your name
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will put a full stop. What is your name.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is a question. It needs a question mark.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. What is your name? That is asking, so a question mark!

parent_line: Can choose a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark to end a sentence.
